email.note: Illustrative stack. Contentful and Salesforce are example vendor choices.

member.note: The website verifies membership. The email URL alone grants no ticket access.

cms.note: Custom illustrative Contentful model; the website applies eligibility rules.

tickets.note: Illustrative handoff; no live inventory or prices are presented.

followup.note: Requires an agreed ticketing-to-marketing integration. A click is not a purchase.

signin.note: No credentials are collected by this walkthrough.

verified.note: Ticketmaster still enforces its own eligibility rules.

expired.note: Old emails remain clickable after a campaign ends.

fields: This offer's over. Your next night isn't.
paused.note: Published fallback content keeps an old campaign link useful.

general.note: No promotional price or member benefit carries into this fallback.
